summary: StepStone Private Credit Fund LLC filed an 8-K reporting that on September 14, 2026, it, as collateral manager, and its wholly-owned SPV subsidiary StepStone SPV Facility VII LLC, as borrower, entered a $250.0 million revolving Credit Agreement with Goldman Sachs Bank USA as administrative agent, UMB Bank as collateral administrator/custodian/agent, and lenders. Borrowings bear term SOFR plus 1.90%, subject to a borrowing base, secured by SPV assets and equity pledges. A make-whole premium of 2%/1% applies to early commitment reductions before September 14, 2028. This is a routine credit facility, not a special situation; watch facility covenants and borrowing-base headroom.
